No source access recovery, robots/terms engine, PDF parser, exact-family pricing adapter, LLM classification, power-loss/multi-platform proof or automatic release is delivered. Hash/attempt completeness does not establish claim freshness. No public UI changes; desktop/mobile/keyboard page QA and production site release are not claimed.
confidence: High deterministic bounded accounting and observed fake interruption controls; live reliability and source/claim quality unmeasured
lesson: An attempt and its outcome must be separate durable events; a missing outcome is a hold, not permission to replay. Full inventory accounting and factual freshness remain different.
falsification_trigger: Duplicate attempt, changed-manifest execution, denied/unknown replay, private result persistence, lost source clock, partial coverage labeled fresh, or a real weekly integration failure
